description_en: Puṇyacandra Bāhāḥ, a branch of Su Bāhāḥ (LAL1920, also called Jayamanohara Mahāvihāra), is located in the Subāhāḥ area, behind the Subāhāḥ'sdyaḥchẽ. Thisbāhāḥfaces east and can be accessed via the southeastern door of the main Subāhāḥ courtyard. An alley on the eastern side also leads to the complex. The main sanctum is built on the monastic building of the Subāhāḥ and makes use of the southeastern corner of the ground floor, which is plastered with lime. Two open arcades can be found on either side of the sanctum. The small courtyard is paved with concrete tiles and measures 7.7 m x 4.2 m. Adharmadhātumaṇḍalasits in the courtyard and is located directly in front of the sanctum. Curved bricknāgvaḥand plastering have been used to construct the base of the sanctum's door.Locke(1985, 82) has named this monument Pūrṇasundara Bāhāḥ. However, this name seems problematic: the stone inscription attached to thedharmadhātumaṇḍalaclearly calls it Puṇyacandra. Thebāhāḥwas constructed by Puṇyarāja Śākya, who had three daughters but no sons. After establishing thebāhāḥin NS 1062 (1942) and after the ritual worship of the Dvādaśa Tīrtha and Aṣṭavaitarāga Tīrtha, his wife bore three sons. RS 50 was expended for the construction of thekvāḥpāḥdyaḥand RS 100 was spent on thedharmadhātumaṇḍala. The woodentoraṇainstalled above the entrance of thedyaḥchẽshows an image of Akṣobhya. Underneath it, one can find an inscription. The sanctum is home to a stone image of Akṣobhya.
description_ne: यो विहार सुबाहा: (जयमनोहर महाविहार) को शाखा विहार हो । लक (1985, 82) ले यस बाहा:लाई पूर्णसुन्दर बाहा: भनी लेखेका छन् जुन गलत छ । अभिलेखमा यसलाई पुण्यचन्द्र विहार नै भनिएको छ । सुबाहा:मा बस्ने पुण्यराज शाक्यले बनाएको हुनाले यसलाई उनकै नामबाट यसलाई पुण्यचन्द्र बाहा: भनिएको हो । पुण्यराज शाक्यको तीन छोरी भए पनि छोरा नभएकोले नेसं १०६२ (सन् 1942) मा यो विहार बनाएर द्वादशतीर्थ, अष्टवैतराग तीर्थमा पूजाआजा गरेपछि तीन छोरा जन्मेका थिए । विहार बनाउँदा क्वा:पा:द्य:को लागि रु. ५० र धर्मधातुको लागि रु. १०० खर्च भएको थियो । विहारसँगै द्य:छेँको पूर्वमा धर्मधातु मण्डल पनि स्थापना गरिएको थियो ।सुबाहा:को द्य:छेँको पछाडिको मोहडामा भुइँतलामा पूर्वाभिमुख गरी यो विहार बनाइएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकाको माथि काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । उक्त तोरणको मध्य भागमा अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध अंकित गरिएको छ । यसै तोरणमा विहार निर्माणसम्बन्धी अभिलेख कुँदिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र अक्षोभ्यको ढुंगाको मूर्तिलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । विहार परिसरमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: Puṇyarāja Śākya's wife bore three sons after her husband established thisbāhāḥand performed the ritual worship at the Dvādaśa Tīrtha and Aṣṭavaitarāga Tīrtha.
Pūṇyarāja Śākya, his wife Vyatimāyā, and their three daughters Buramāya, Kṛnsamāya (Kṛṣṇamāyā) and Nandamāyā constructed thisdharmadhātu maṇḍalatogether with thebāhāḥ.
